info.name: VNeCA Unified v2 — Operator Setup & Preflight
info.description: Separate real Platform operator login/RBAC. No admin credential becomes a customer bearer. Read current scope; NOT_CHECKED is not PASS. Write requests are manually armed, require owner-prepared exact JSON/PoP and are never executed by the supplied scripts. Internal-only activation/signing-use/verifier workflows remain CLI/owner steps, not fictitious public APIs.

exec: (async()=>{pm.execution.setNextRequest(null);if(pm.environment.get('platform_origin')!=='https://127.0.0.1:29443'){pm.execution.skipRequest();throw Error('Wrong measured TEST control plane');}pm.variables.set('platform_origin',pm.environment.get('platform_origin'));const mode='LOGIN';if(mode==='LOGIN'){const username=await pm.vault.get(pm.environment.get('operator_username_vault_key')),password=await pm.vault.get(pm.environment.get('operator_password_vault_key'));pm.request.body.update(JSON.stringify({username,password}));}else{if(mode==='WRITE'){if(pm.environment.get('operator_once')!=='00 LOGIN — credentials from Local Vault'){pm.execution.skipRequest();throw Error('Exact manual operator_once required; no automatic provisioning/activation');}pm.environment.unset('operator_once');const raw=pm.environment.get('operator_prepared_json');if(!raw||!JSON.parse(raw)){pm.execution.skipRequest();throw Error('Real workflow prepared JSON/PoP required');}pm.request.body.update(raw);}const token=await pm.vault.get(pm.environment.get('operator_jwt_vault_key'));if(!token){pm.execution.skipRequest();throw Error('Real operator login required');}pm.request.headers.upsert({key:'Authorization',value:'Bearer '+token});}})().catch(()=>{pm.execution.skipRequest();throw Error('Operator credential/scope/prepared-command unavailable; no HTTP sent');});

(async()=>{pm.execution.setNextRequest(null);pm.test('Real operator login HTTP201',()=>pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(201));if(pm.response.code!==201)return;const j=pm.response.json(),token=j.data?.access_token;if(!token)throw Error('No real login token');await pm.vault.set(pm.environment.get('operator_jwt_vault_key'),token);})().catch(()=>{pm.test('Operator token remains private',()=>{throw Error('Login/Vault failed');});});
